<quote by="Announced by Protectorate Thenrik, Legion Engineer">To commission the construction of the Great Aqueduct of Eoradal in Mareave to bring water to that region.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs an [[edifice]] in Clisearn, [[Mareave]] as per the '''[[Million_miles_of_water#The_Eoradal_Tunnels|Million miles of water]]''' wind of fortune
* Announcement by the [[Legion Engineer]]
==Date==
* Winter 386YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 12 white granite
* 4 weirwood
* 4 mithril
* 15 crowns (caused by the underdeveloped nature of Icarion)
* 12 thrones upkeep
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Great_Aqueduct_of_Eoradal}}
==Outcome==
Now complete, the aqueduct is using water purchased from the Skourans of Jadefall:

*Supplies fresh water to the main settlement in Eoradal.
*Enables the region to support a large town once Curstag's Way is also completed, increasing taxation here by 4 thrones a season.
*Removes the arid quality from the region while it is operational
